decisions.reason: Having survived two seasons as a prominently presented multi-item line in the core natural skincare business, it likely meets or comes close enough to aspiration levels to be retained.

As a close-to-core cleansing product that has already passed one review point but with lower prominence than A, it still looks more likely to be continued while results accumulate than to have its resources redeployed.

Because it is the newest and least proven item, a small boundedly rational firm would monitor it closely, but its strong fit with the established facial-care offer still favors keeping it for now rather than dropping it immediately.
